notes.text:
Enable Rapid PVST+ on all switches
Set CSW1 primary for VLANs 10 and 20 and secondary for 30 and 40
Set CSW2 primary for VLANs 30 and 40 and secondary for 10 and 20
Verify the root bridge for each VLAN
Identify root, designated and alternate ports
Test redundant uplink failover
Enable PortFast and BPDU Guard on PC ports
Practise Root Guard, Loop Guard and BPDU Filter
notes.html:
1. Enable Rapid PVST+ on all switches

  2. Set CSW1 primary for VLANs 10 and 20 and secondary for 30 and 40

  3. Set CSW2 primary for VLANs 30 and 40 and secondary for 10 and 20

  4. Verify the root bridge for each VLAN

  5. Identify root, designated and alternate ports

  6. Test redundant uplink failover

  7. Enable PortFast and BPDU Guard on PC ports

  8. Practise Root Guard, Loop Guard and BPDU Filter
